title: PRICE MATCH GUARANTEE
officialText:
At COZEWARE, we believe that quality and price should go hand in hand. Our philosophy is to transform the air in your life with smarter technology, cleaner air and thoughtful design, reflecting our commitment to providing outstanding quality and value.
If you find the same item (must be identical in brand name, size, appearance, weight, color, and model number) at a lower price on another platform or sales channel, we'll be more than happy to match the price. Additionally, If our prices drop within 30 days of your purchase with us, we'll refund you the difference.
TERMS AND CONDITIONS
Item must be identical in brand name, size, weight, color, quantity, material, and model number.
To qualify for a price match, both our offer and the lower price offer must be published, valid, and must be in stock. Customers are required to provide either a photograph or the original complete offer displaying the valid lower price.
Price match or refund claims must be submitted within 30 days before or after your Cozeware purchase.
We reserve the right to verify an advertised price and the availability of the item.
Only one price match per identical item per person.
Price matching applies to online purchases only.
EXCLUSIONS
Offers including financing, bundled items, clearance sales, free gifts, buy-one-get-one deals, or promotions without a displayed retail price.
Typographical errors, mail-in rebates, instant discounts, or competitor service fees (e.g., shipping).
Items that are advertised as limited-quantity, out-of-stock, open-box, clearance, refurbished/used, closeout, damaged product or liquidation sales, or sold by resellers/clearance websites.
Category-wide or storewide discounts, coupon-required prices,non-branded items, credit card promotions, or minimum-purchase requirements.
Prices that only display on a website after guests log in.
